description: Search the public web through the MiniMax Mavis gateway and return result titles, URLs and snippets. Results are summaries only; use mavis_extract_web to read a page body.

count.description: Number of results to return, 1-50; defaults to 10.

freshness.description: Time window of the results; omit for no limit.

search_type.description: Kind of results; the underlying search source is routed by the server.
